hypothesis: Test conservative visual-rule transfer and whether decision dependence adds useful review evidence without flagging genuine annotated cancer.
transfer_rule: strict score greater than every original clean-fold threshold; any unavailable threshold abstains
physical_size_isolation: Report occupied footprint and isolation only; no newly fitted size or isolation cutoffs
limitations: Fresh clean/S1 outcomes already known; this is an evaluated development cohort, not pristine independent policy validation
Original clean-fold thresholds used RGB topology; transfer uses fixed sampled occupied cells, so original burden calibration does not carry over
Native annotations and synthetic truth enter evaluation only, never flags or anomaly features
Replacement exclusions target native carriers and may remove extra genuine evidence
Random draws are matched to combined component count per bag; 32 draws are not independent cases or patients
Bootstrap resamples unique hosts with all repeated bags/draws retained; conditional on fixed donors and policy, unknown patient overlap
Single-component exclusions remain unevaluable and in all-slide burden denominators
Strict thresholds can yield no useful recall; no post-outcome relaxation or final readiness follows
